description: Theological glossary for Protestant church sermon translation (12 languages)

categories.trinity: Terms related to the Holy Trinity
categories.christology: Terms related to Christ and His work
categories.sacraments: Terms related to sacraments and ordinances
categories.scripture: Terms related to the Bible and revelation
categories.liturgy: Terms related to worship and liturgy
categories.eschatology: Terms related to end times and eternal life
categories.pneumatology: Terms related to the Holy Spirit
categories.citations: Scripture citation formulas and prophetic phrases

eingeweiht.context: spiritual initiation in Philippians 4:12, not secret society

gegründet.context: church planting — Paul founded churches across the Roman Empire

Elfenbeinturm.context: idiom — detachment from reality, academic isolation

translations.es: con los pies en la tierra

Bodenhaftung.context: idiom — pragmatism, being grounded, opposite of Elfenbeinturm

Wachsoldat.context: Roman guard soldier — Paul was chained to a rotating guard (Philippians 1:13). Wach = guard/watch, NOT wax

Umfeld.context: surroundings, environment, circle of people around someone. NOT Mund (mouth)
